title: Aram and Ethical Imagination
excerpt: Why Aram remains one of the most accessible and morally urgent entry points into Jaya Mohan's fiction.
content:
Aram and Ethical Imagination

Aram is often recommended as a first encounter with Jaya Mohan because of its clarity and emotional force. The stories are simple on the surface, but each one opens into difficult moral questions.

Rather than offering neat solutions, the collection asks readers to inhabit ambiguity: how to act when duty, compassion, and social rules collide. This ethical tension gives the stories their long afterlife in public conversations.

Across classrooms, book clubs, and online readers' circles, Aram continues to be discussed as literature that is both artistically strong and socially alert.
